functions_changed: _resolve_entry_point (resolve both store EP and load EP)
files_modified.behavior_before: Gate resolved only entry_point_id (load-leg) for all findings. Auth check used load-leg EP type. Guard check ran on load-leg EP only. No IR supplement support.
files_modified.behavior_after: When finding has store_entry_point_id: gate resolves BOTH load EP (for path/sink checks) and store EP (write-leg). Auth check uses write-leg EP type — attacker access level = lowest auth needed to inject. Guard check runs on BOTH legs; minimum score governs; contradiction on either leg = 0.0. IR supplement (reports/phase1/<slug>-ir-supplement.json) loaded optionally at startup — resolved_dynamic:<hash> EPs merged into ep_by_id. Graceful fallback when supplement absent or store EP not in IR. Single-EP findings: all original behavior unchanged.

discovered_issues.description: guards_by_ep index in __init__ only covers base IR guards, not supplement guards. If supplement entries have guards[] (unlikely for Agent D resolved EPs but possible), they will not appear in guards_by_ep. Impact: guard check for supplement EPs will show 'no guard detected' rather than actual guard state.
